settings.question: How long before I notice a difference?
settings.answer: Most customers notice less bloating and smoother digestion within the first 1–2 weeks. Energy and clarity typically improve around weeks 3–6. For deeper liver support, 3–6 months of consistent use delivers the best results.†

settings.question: How do I take LiverWell?
settings.answer: Take 2 capsules daily with water, preferably with a meal. For best results, take them at the same time each day.

settings.question: Why should I choose the 2 or 3 bottle bundle?
settings.answer: Liver support is a process, not an event. The first month starts the shift; deeper support builds from months 2–6. Customers who report the biggest changes stay consistent — bundles also give you the best price per bottle.

settings.question: What makes LiverWell different from other milk thistle supplements?
settings.answer: Our milk thistle is standardized to 80% silymarin — the clinical threshold — and paired with 5 supporting ingredients for digestion and energy. No proprietary blends, no fillers, every batch third-party tested.

settings.question: Do I need to change my diet or quit drinking?
settings.answer: No. LiverWell is designed to fit into your life as-is. Healthy habits always help, but you don't need to overhaul your lifestyle to support your liver.

settings.question: Can I take it with other supplements or medications?
settings.answer: LiverWell works well alongside most everyday supplements. Milk thistle may interact with certain medications (such as blood thinners, some diabetes medications and immunosuppressants), so if you take prescription medication, are pregnant or nursing, please consult your doctor first. If you're allergic to plants in the daisy family (ragweed, marigolds), check with your doctor before use.

settings.question: Is it for men and women?
settings.answer: Yes — LiverWell is formulated for adults of all genders who want daily liver, digestive and energy support.

settings.question: What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.answer: Every order is protected by our 90-day money-back guarantee. If you don't feel the difference, contact us and we'll refund your order — even if the bottle is empty.
